note: Abivax's lead asset obefazimod targets moderate-to-severely active ulcerative colitis. US adult UC prevalence anchor: Kappelman et al, Clin Gastroenterol Hepatol 2007 (PMID 17904915, ingested at data/ABVX/pubmed/17904915.json), a national-sample study reporting adult UC prevalence ~238/100,000, i.e. roughly 0.6-1.0M US adults. The addressable moderate-to-severe treated segment is a subset; the band brackets all-adult UC down to the treated population. Single lead commercial indication -- no aggregation with Crohn's.
